### SQL Data Types

| Category | Data Type | Description | Storage Size | Example |
|-----------|------------|--------------|---------------|----------|
| **Int** | `TINYINT` | 0 to 255 | 1 byte | 120 |
|  | `SMALLINT` | -32,768 to 32,767 | 2 bytes | -100 |
|  | `INT` | -2,147,483,648 to 2,147,483,647 | 4 bytes | 1000 |
|  | `BIGINT` | Very large integer | 8 bytes | 9000000000 |
| **Float** | `DECIMAL(p,s)` | Fixed-point number, p = precision, s = scale | Depends on precision | `DECIMAL(6,2)` → 1234.56 |
|  | `FLOAT` | Approximate floating-point number | 4–8 bytes | 3.14 |
|  | `REAL` | Single-precision floating-point number | 4 bytes | 2.718 |
| **Char** | `CHAR(n)` | Fixed-length string | n bytes | `'A'`, `'SQL  '` |
|  | `VARCHAR(n)` | Variable-length string | Actual string length | `'Hello'` |
|  | `TEXT` | Long text (up to 2GB, deprecated) | Variable | `'Long text...'` |
| **Date** | `DATE` | Date only (YYYY-MM-DD) | 3 bytes | `2025-11-04` |
|  | `TIME` | Time only (HH:MM:SS) | 3–5 bytes | `14:30:00` |
|  | `DATETIME` | Date + Time | 8 bytes | `2025-11-04 14:30:00` |
|  | `SMALLDATETIME` | Date + Time (minute precision) | 4 bytes | `2025-11-04 14:00` |
|  | `DATETIME2` | Date + Time (higher precision) | 6–8 bytes | `2025-11-04 14:30:00.123` |
| **Boolean** | `BIT` | 0 or 1 (TRUE/FALSE) | 1 bit | 0 / 1 |
| **Binary** | `BINARY(n)` | Fixed-length binary data | n bytes | `0x1234` |
|  | `VARBINARY(n)` | Variable-length binary data | Actual length | `0xFFEE` |
|  | `IMAGE` | Large binary data (deprecated) | Variable | File data |
| **Other** | `UNIQUEIDENTIFIER` | GUID-style unique ID | 16 bytes | `6F9619FF-8B86-D011-B42D-00CF4FC964FF` |
|  | `XML` | Stores XML-formatted data | Variable | `<person><name>John</name></person>` |


### Data Definition Language DDL

**Create, Alter, Rename, Truncate & Drop**

```{.SQL}
-- Create Database
CREATE DATABASE MYDATABASE

-- Create Table
USE [MYDATABASE]

CREATE TABLE [MYTABLE](
[COL1] VARCHAR(10) PRIMARY KEY,
[COL2] INT NOT NULL
)

-- Add Column
ALTER TABLE [MYTABLE] ADD [col3] DATE

-- Change Col Type
ALTER TABLE [MYTABLE] ALTER COLUMN [col3] INT

-- Rename Col
SP_RENAME '[MYTABLE].[col3]', 'col4'

-- Rename Table
SP_RENAME 'MYTABLE', 'THETABLE'

-- Remove Row Data
TRUNCATE TABLE [THETABLE]

-- Remove Table
DROP TABLE [THETABLE]

-- Remove Col
ALTER TABLE [THETABLE] DROP COLUMN [col4]


```

### Data Manipulation Language DML

**Insert, Select, Update, Delete**


```{.SQL}

-- Insert
INSERT INTO [MYTABLE] VALUES ('char', 5)

-- Select
SELECT * -- all columns
    FROM [MYTABLE]

SELECT [col1],
        [col2] AS [col3]
    FROM [MYTABLE]

-- Update
UPDATE [MYTABLE]
    SET [col2] = 1

UPDATE [MYTABLE]
    SET [col2] = 2
    WHERE [col1] = 'A'

-- Check
SELECT *
    FROM [MYTABLE]

-- Delete
DELETE
    FROM [MYTABLE]

DELETE
    FROM [MYTABLE]
    WHERE [col1] = 'A'

```


### Data Control Language DCL

**Grant & Revoke**

```{.SQL}
-- Grant
GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON [MYTABLE] TO SOMEUSER WITH GRANT OPTION
-- GRANT OPTION: OTHERUSER CAN GRANT OTHER

-- Revoke
REVOKE SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON [MYTABLE] TO SOMEUSER WITH CASCADE
-- REVOKE: REVOKE OTHERUSER including OTHER
```


### Transaction Control Language TCL

**Commit, Rollback, Savepoint**

```{.SQL}
-- Transaction & Save Points
USE MYTABLE

BEGIN TRAN

SAVE TRAN S1;
INSERT INTO [MYTABLE] VALUES ('B', 2)

SAVE TRAN S2
UPDATE [MYTABLE] SET [col2] = 0 WHERE [col1] = 'A'

SELECT * FROM [MYTABLE]

ROLLBACK TRAN S1

SELECT * FROM [MYTABLE]
```



SELECT FROM WHERE GROUP BY HAVING ORDER BY

FROM: Select table
WHERE: Filter
GROUP BY: Group by column
HAVING: Filter within group
SELECT: Select column
ORDER BY: Order
